title: PatternCandidate
description: A repeated VERIFIED decision shape discovered by the pattern miner across many WorkflowTraces (e.g. 'whenever conflict_type=deadline_mismatch AND source_a.authority>source_b.authority on the same fact_key, the verified winner was always the higher-authority source'). It is an OBSERVATION, not a rule and not truth: it records the decision signature, how many distinct VERIFIED traces support it, the supporting trace ids (lossless link back to evidence), and any counter-observations. supported_by_trace_ids MUST all reference verified traces; a pattern mined from any unverified/reversed/stale/tenant-private-as-global trace is rejected upstream. Deterministic when created_at is injected.

pattern_id.description: content-addressed id over (decision_signature + sorted supporting trace ids); deterministic

source_scope.description: a tenant_private pattern can only become a global rule after anonymization + approval

pattern_type.description: the category of repeated decision observed

decision_signature.description: a canonical, hashable signature of the decision shape (the IF→THEN skeleton observed across traces)

input_feature_keys.description: the input fields the decision keyed on (e.g. conflict_type, source_a.authority, fact_key, scope)

observed_decision.description: the VERIFIED outcome that recurred (e.g. 'winner=higher_authority_source, loser=held_out')

support_count.description: number of distinct verified traces exhibiting this pattern; higher = stronger candidate

supported_by_trace_ids.description: the WorkflowTrace ids that support this pattern (lossless link to evidence); ALL must be verified

counterexample_trace_ids.description: verified traces with the same inputs but a DIFFERENT outcome; present even if empty — non-empty weakens the candidate

all_traces_verified.description: structurally pinned true: the miner only emits a pattern when every supporting trace is verified
